documents.notes: 'Documents to support your application'. After applying, an email lists the documents required.

items.quote: Evidence of your name, date of birth, name changes, citizenship or residency Birth certificate, or Relevant pages of your passport, or Citizenship certificate
items.condition: one of a birth certificate, the relevant passport pages or a citizenship certificate is accepted as evidence of identity; it must be certified

items.quote: Overseas secondary school You can submit your secondary school transcript if you have completed your studies overseas.
If your documents are in a language other than English, you must provide the original language version and the English translation.
items.condition: your documents are in a language other than English

items.quote: Evidence of English language proficiency (4) IELTS or TOEFL or equivalent.
items.notes: Footnote 4: 'International applicants or domestic applicants whose first language is not English need to meet English language requirements.'

items.quote: Additional documents Supplementary forms, interviews, portfolios or auditions. After you apply, we will email you with any additional requirements and how to complete them.
items.condition: the programme asks for it after you apply
